text:
maria_cs: Kaplan onboarding — quick sync. They want formal SLA acceptance + a clear credit-staging plan before renewal review. Customer baseline: uptime 99.9% (monthly), embeddings p95 <= 150ms. They also asked for a one-page evidence bundle they can hand to procurement.

jason_se: Got it. Do we have runbook steps for the acceptance tests? I can run an embedding workload and capture p95. Need to confirm test window and traffic shape.

maria_cs: Test window: 48h synthetic + 7d sampled production traces. Traffic shape: bursty spikes (simulated qps~120) + steady 20 qps. Can you also include KV/prefix cache enabled in Dedicated? Kaplan is on Dedicated.

oliver_sre: For evidence bundle, we'll need: dashboard export (uptime timeline), p50/p95/p99 latency histograms, error-rate by route, and synthetic probe logs. I can export screenshots + raw CSVs. Quick how-to for synthetic run:
```bash
# run locust-like workload (internal tool)
infra-load --target kaplan-dedicated --qps 120 --dur 2h --payload embeddings
# collect p95
query-metrics --trace p95 --service embeddings --window 2h > kaplan_p95_2h.csv
```
I'll drop artifacts in //redwood-cs/kaplan/onboarding/evidence/ if that's OK.

beth_support: I'll draft the customer-facing acceptance note and credit table. Suggest the email includes: SLA thresholds, observed metrics (with dates), credit formula, and next steps for signoff. I'll paste a template once oliver uploads artifacts. :+1:

karen_revops: Heads up — renewal baseline flags Kaplan as medium risk until SLA accepted. We need signoff by EOD next Tue to avoid discounting controls in the renewal quote. Can we set a firm handoff date?

maria_cs: Proposed timeline:
- Today: scope & owners (this thread)
- 48h: synthetic + 2nd party run (jason + oliver)
- 7d: production sample analysis (oliver)
- Day 9: deliver evidence bundle (artifacts + email) (beth)
- Day 10: customer signoff window opens (kaplan reply)
Agree?

jason_se: Agree. I'll start the synthetic tomorrow 09:00 PST. Will enable KV cache and annotate traces.

oliver_sre: I'll provision the probe and schedule the dashboard export for Day 2 & Day 8. Uploads go to the shared folder. Also FYI: if we see cold-start spikes during the synthetic, we'll record them and add a mitigation note (autoscale warmup).

beth_support: Draft email template (short):
"Kaplan team — attached is the SLA acceptance evidence for uptime 99.9% and embeddings p95 <= 150ms. Items included: dashboard exports, latency histograms, synthetic run logs, and credit calculation. Please review and reply with signoff or questions by Day 10"
I'll attach a simple credit table:
- If monthly uptime < 99.9% and >= 99.5% => 5% credit of monthly invoice
- If monthly uptime < 99.5% => 15% credit
- Latency SLO: if p95 > 150ms for 7d rolling => case-by-case credit (documented in attachment)

maria_cs: @karen_revops please confirm the credit thresholds are okay for renewal pricing. If not, propose alt numbers here.

karen_revops: Numbers fine for now. If Kaplan pushes back, we'll escalate to sales lead but keep the 5%/15% ladder. Make sure legal sees the one-pager before sending.

oliver_sre: Uploaded initial synthetic logs: //redwood-cs/kaplan/onboarding/evidence/3419876543_synthetic_run.zip (summary csv + raw traces). Dashboard snapshots uploaded as PNGs. Noted a 220ms transient at 00:42 during a cold start — added note.

deploy-bot: deploy status: synthetic-probe v2.3 started on kaplan-dedicated at 3419877100; job id: probe-9832.

jason_se: Saw the 220ms spike — I re-ran with pre-warm and p95 came down to 138ms for embeddings. Will include both runs (cold vs warm) in the bundle to justify steady-state numbers.

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: 
- jason_se: run full 48h synthetic and drop p95 CSVs (owner)
- oliver_sre: run production sample exports and final dashboard snapshots (owner)
- beth_support: legal review + draft email + attach credit table (owner)
- karen_revops: confirm renewal pricing flags and standby for escalation (owner)
I'll close loop with Kaplan on Day 9 with the bundle and proposed credit table.

beth_support: I'll ping legal now and post the reviewed email here for signoff.

karen_revops: Thx team — please @me when the bundle is ready. If Kaplan signs off early, we'll accelerate renewal cadence. :rocket:

maria_cs: Thanks all. Keeping thread for evidence uploads and final customer note. If anything blocks, call it out and tag the channel.

(END OF THREAD)
